summary: RADCOM LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held May 20, 2026, where shareholders approved most agenda items including an amendment to the company's Amended and Restated Articles of Association, except Item 4 (not brought to vote due to director resignations). The filing also attaches the updated Articles. This is a routine governance update with no disclosed financial terms, premium, or structural special situation elements. There is no acquisition, tender offer, or strategic event evident. The filing simply records shareholder approval of corporate housekeeping amendments.
